newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's TV Azteca plans 4-4.6 bln peso IPO Aug 14.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's TV Azteca plans 4-4.6 bln peso IPO Aug 14.

text.p: Mexico's second largest television network TV Azteca plans to offer between 4.040 and 4.579 billion pesos when it goes public on August 14, the company's term sheet said.

The term sheet, a copy of which was obtained by Reuters, said Azteca would offer a total of approximately 136 million CPO shares at a price of 29.70-33.66 pesos on the Mexican Stock Exchange (BMV), the New York Stock Exchange and the London international SEAQ market.
The amount placed would be equivalent to 22 percent of Azteca's shareholding equity and would be one of the largest Mexican IPOs since the December 1994 peso devaluation crisis.
An overallotment of up to 15 percent of CPO shares offered will be available, the company added.
Of the total initial placement, approximately 800 million pesos will be on offer in Mexico.
Joint lead managers in Mexico will be the Serfin and Inbursa brokerages.
"Funds obtained from the primary placement will be mainly chanelled into expansion plans," the term sheet added.
Only 8 percent of the offering will be new stock, Azteca said.
